extensionDescription.message: Shows when your requests go through an intermediary that decrypts them, such as Cloudflare, Akamai or Imperva.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension, shown in the add-ons manager.

titleNeutral.message: No request seen in this tab goes through a known intermediary.
titleNeutral.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon when no request seen in the tab goes through a known provider.

titleNotObserved.message: Site not observed: the extension's access to this site was withdrawn, so it can say nothing about it.
titleNotObserved.description: Tooltip of the toolbar icon when the extension has no access to the site of the tab and saw nothing.

countLevel2One.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 2, blue, when there is one.

countLevel2Many.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 2, blue, when there are several.

countLevel3ProvenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, red, when there is one.

countLevel3ProvenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, red, when there are several.

countLevel3UnprovenOne.message: Level 3, reading: 1 request, decryption not proven
countLevel3UnprovenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, orange, when there is one.

countLevel3UnprovenMany.message: Level 3, reading: $COUNT$ requests, decryption not proven
countLevel3UnprovenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 3, orange, when there are several.

countLevel4ProvenOne.message: Level 4, personal data: 1 request, decryption proven
countLevel4ProvenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, red, when there is one.

countLevel4ProvenMany.message: Level 4, personal data: $COUNT$ requests, decryption proven
countLevel4ProvenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, red, when there are several.

countLevel4UnprovenOne.message: Level 4, personal data: 1 request, decryption not proven
countLevel4UnprovenOne.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, orange, when there is one.

countLevel4UnprovenMany.message: Level 4, personal data: $COUNT$ requests, decryption not proven
countLevel4UnprovenMany.description: Line of the tooltip that counts the requests of the tab at level 4, orange, when there are several.

titleBlue.message: $PROVIDER$ serves public resources of this page: it knows you are visiting it, and when.
titleBlue.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the provider of the most serious request of the tab sees: blue, levels 1 and 2.

titleOrange.message: This page goes through $PROVIDER$, which may see in clear everything it exchanges with the site.
titleOrange.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the provider of the most serious request of the tab sees: orange, levels 3 and 4, decryption not proven.

titleRed.message: $PROVIDER$ sees in clear everything this page exchanges with the site: web addresses, pages, cookies and forms.
titleRed.description: Line of the tooltip that says what the provider of the most serious request of the tab sees: red, levels 3 and 4, decryption proven.

titleSessionProven.message: Cookies or a login token are part of it, and they can be enough to get into your account.
titleSessionProven.description: Line added to the tooltip when the tab saw a request through a provider that carries a cookie of the site or an Authorization header, and the decryption of one such request was proven.

titleSessionUnproven.message: Cookies or a login token would be part of it, and they could be enough to get into your account.
titleSessionUnproven.description: Line added to the tooltip when the tab saw a request through a provider that carries a cookie of the site or an Authorization header, and the decryption of none was proven.

titleAntiBotProven.message: Part of these exchanges comes from its anti-bot protection.
titleAntiBotProven.description: Line added to the tooltip when the tab saw a request of the anti-bot machinery of a provider, and the decryption of one such request was proven. "Its" is the provider named in the line before.

titleAntiBotUnproven.message: Part of these exchanges would come from its anti-bot protection.
titleAntiBotUnproven.description: Line added to the tooltip when the tab saw a request of the anti-bot machinery of a provider, and the decryption of none was proven. "Its" is the provider named in the line before.

titlePartial.message: Partial view: the extension does not have access to every site, so it shows only what it saw.
titlePartial.description: Line added to the tooltip when the extension lacks the access to all sites.

titleMissed.message: Partial view: the extension could not see every request of this page.
titleMissed.description: Line added to the tooltip when the extension got the response of a request whose sending it never saw, or started after the page did.

popupPage.description: Title of the popup section that shows the counts of the displayed page.

popupUnit.description: Unit at the right of a popup section title whose rows count requests.

popupSite.description: Title of the popup section that shows the kept counts of the site, with the date they started.

popupSitePrivate.description: Title of the popup section that shows the counts of the site in a private window, which live only for the private session.

popupBrowserPage.description: Shown in place of the site name in the popup when the tab shows a page of the browser, reader view included.

popupUnknownSite.description: Shown in place of the site name in the popup when the tab shows a website whose site the extension does not know.

popupNothingBrowser.message: No site is shown, so there is nothing to count.
popupNothingBrowser.description: Popup notice for a page of the browser, which has no site to count, shown only when the popup shows nothing else of the page.

popupNothingSite.message: No request seen on this site went through a known intermediary.
popupNothingSite.description: Popup notice under the site title when no request of the site went through a known provider.

popupClearAll.description: Popup button that asks to clear the kept counts of every site, or in a private window the counts of the private session.

popupClear.description: Popup button that confirms the clearing of the counts the popup shows.

popupCancel.description: Popup button that gives up the clearing of the counts the popup shows.

popupClearQuestion.message: Clear the counts of every site kept since $DATE$?
popupClearQuestion.description: Question the popup asks before it clears the kept counts of every site, with the date they started.

popupClearQuestionPrivate.message: Clear the counts of this private session?
popupClearQuestionPrivate.description: Question the popup of a private window asks before it clears the counts of the private session, and nothing of the kept counts.

level1.description: Name of leak level 1 in a row of the popup.

level2.description: Name of leak level 2 in a row of the popup.

level3.description: Name of leak level 3 in a row of the popup.

level4.description: Name of leak level 4 in a row of the popup.

decryptionProven.description: Proof line under a red row of the popup.

decryptionUnproven.description: Proof line under an orange row of the popup.
